values: Assam Study Journal • brand colours and unchanged heritage artwork • concrete layout rules and embedded cover references
Headlines, emphasis, woven edges, wordmark and CTA areas.
Body copy, question options and careful line illustration.
Default learning page. Keep texture faint and optional.
Clean screenshot panels and original Rang Ghar artwork background.
Correct answers and completed steps, with an explicit text label.
White text on green; green labels on white
Portrait 4:5; export all slides at the same size. Keep essential content 80 px inside every edge.
Calm learning pages with familiar local detail. Keep about 80% of the frame devoted to the question or explanation.
Cover 76–84 px semibold; body 40–44 px regular; option text 44 px; footer/source 24–28 px. Adjust wrapping, never shrink a dense lesson.
Use complete, fluent-reviewed Assamese translations. Preserve numbers/options; allow more line space and verify the final glyphs.
Wordmark top left at x80/y80. Use original Rang Ghar image top right, about 170 px wide with original proportions and generous clear space.
Start around x80/y240. Limit the cover to one clear question or situation, normally 8–12 words across 2–3 lines.
Prefer 15–35 words. Put equations/options on separate lines. If copy exceeds the space, add a slide rather than compressing type.
Abstract red-and-ivory geometric edging inspired by gamosa borders. Use a 20–28 px footer strip or a narrow bookmark, not a full patterned background.
A simple flowing line connects a question to the next step. Keep 3–4 px stroke and generous space; it is a reading guide, not a geographic map.
Use the supplied Rang Ghar artwork unchanged. Reserve larger treatment for the GK carousel. Do not stretch, redraw, rotate, crop details or combine it with text.
Use ordinary notebook, pencil and tea-cup references when the lesson calls for them. Tea leaves are optional only in a tea-related episode.
Options remain charcoal on ivory/white until the reveal. Never highlight the correct option on an attempt slide.
Use #3F6B4F with an explicit “Correct answer” label. The answer must be understandable without colour.
Prefer precise line art and owned photographs with natural rooms and skin texture. Keep paper grain faint and away from small text.
Use actual mobile screenshots and visible access rules. Layout references contain a screenshot slot until live evidence is captured.
Wordmark left, counter right, source line when needed. Keep the main CTA only on the final slide; use one action per post.
Treat motifs as design inspiration. Do not label the abstract border as an authentic textile pattern, or merge distinct community attire into one generic Assam costume.
Avoid festival-poster collages, busy gradients, random jaapi/xorai/rhino decoration, fake analytics, rank guarantees and novelty fonts.
The board demonstrates the visual language. Use the exact copy in Slide by Slide when producing the final cards.
One short hook in upper half, one hero image below, fixed header/footer.
A short statement with two clear fields or a large image and compact explanation.
Question first; evenly spaced neutral options; answer withheld until a later card.
Working in aligned lines above a simple truthful diagram; explicit answer label.
One useful action in large text; secondary brand line smaller; no competing request.
